name: x402 Existing Endpoint Gating Without Deployment
query: Add x402 payment gating to this existing HTTP route on Radius testnet. Charge 0.001 SBC per request. Do not choose or configure deployment infrastructure.
context: The user has an existing HTTP API route and wants x402 payment behavior added. Deployment is explicitly out of scope for this skill and should be handled later by the relevant platform skill.
expected_behavior: Uses the x402 server reference and does not choose Cloudflare, Railway, or another hosting platform
Creates an X402Config with network eip155:72344, Radius testnet facilitator URL, SBC asset, payTo, and amount '1000'
Calls processPayment before returning protected content
Returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED when no PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is present
Base64-encoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED includes x402Version: 2, accepts array, permit2 assetTransferMethod, and eip2612GasSponsoring extension
Maps verify-failed to HTTP 402 with a fresh PAYMENT-REQUIRED header
Maps verify-unreachable and settle-unreachable to HTTP 502
Maps settle-failed to HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE failure metadata
Maps settled to protected content with PAYMENT-RESPONSE settlement metadata
Exposes PAYMENT-REQUIRED and PAYMENT-RESPONSE in CORS headers
Leaves deployment as a handoff to a Cloudflare, Wrangler, Railway, or platform-specific skill
success_criteria: No deployment commands are run or recommended as part of x402 integration
No production configuration, secrets, domains, or infrastructure settings are changed
Amount uses 6-decimal raw units: '1000' for 0.001 SBC
The endpoint is payment-ready and can be validated with curl -i before platform deployment
